memory.title_zh: Xe non-fault scratch VM 修复强化显式 VM fault capability
memory.title_en: Xe non-fault scratch VM fix reinforces explicit VM fault capability
memory.impact_zh: faultable/scratch/replay/PASID binding 应成为 VM/context 显式属性；fault handler 先做 capability validation，再进入 HMM/migration/replay。
memory.impact_en: Model faultable/scratch/replay/PASID binding explicitly and validate capability before HMM/migration/replay.

memory.title_zh: AMDGPU mapping-info ioctl 修复强调 VM introspection 的 ownership/unwind
memory.title_en: AMDGPU mapping-info ioctl fix highlights ownership/unwind in VM introspection
memory.impact_zh: 复杂 mapping query 同时持有 GEM ref、exec lock、动态数组时必须统一 cleanup；适用于自研 debug/query uAPI。
memory.impact_en: Complex mapping queries holding object refs, exec locks and dynamic arrays need unified cleanup paths.

virt.title_zh: SR-IOV VF UVD resume 修复暴露 PF/VF resource capability asymmetry
virt.title_en: SR-IOV VF UVD resume fix exposes PF/VF resource capability asymmetry
virt.impact_zh: 每个 VF resource 显式区分 present/initialized/assigned/active/resettable/migratable，reset/reconcile 只处理实际拥有且初始化成功的对象。
virt.impact_en: Track present/initialized/assigned/active/resettable/migratable per VF resource and reconcile only valid resources.

ras.title_zh: AMDGPU KIQ MODE1 reset fence 修复推动 Reset Reconciliation Contract
ras.title_en: AMDGPU KIQ MODE1 reset fence fix motivates a Reset Reconciliation Contract
ras.impact_zh: reset 后必须逐对象定义 HW/memory/SW/FW state survival、sequence realignment、stale completion 与 post-reset validation。
ras.impact_en: Define HW/memory/SW/FW state survival, sequence realignment, stale completion and post-reset validation per object.

ras.title_zh: AMDGPU multi-XCC hang bookkeeping 修复强调 topology cardinality correctness
ras.title_en: AMDGPU multi-XCC hang bookkeeping fix highlights topology cardinality correctness
ras.impact_zh: hang/recovery state 数组必须以真实 XCC/engine/partition cardinality 初始化，避免旧单实例假设泄漏到新拓扑。
ras.impact_en: Initialize hang/recovery state from actual XCC/engine/partition cardinality rather than legacy single-instance assumptions.

fw.title_zh: Tyr MappedBo 将 CPU/GPU mapping 与 FW shared-section lifetime 统一
fw.title_en: Tyr MappedBo unifies CPU/GPU mapping with FW shared-section lifetime
fw.impact_zh: FW shared region 应由单一对象管理 CPU VA、device VA、bounds、coherency 与 FW generation，并集中执行 FW-reported address validation。
fw.impact_en: Use one owner object for CPU VA, device VA, bounds, coherency and FW generation, with centralized validation of FW-reported addresses.
